subject: Re: HyperTransformer kickoff - staffing, compute, dataset caches
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Vera 60%, Saoirse 40%, Carmen 50%. Stable through July 13.
- Compute: transformer training runs fit on 32 titan-a100 best-effort; the semi-supervised sweeps in June push us to ~64 for three weeks. I don't think we need a Vulcan reservation; will revisit if best-effort queues get ugly.
- Data: the trainer consumes datasets as saved NumPy caches (omniglot, miniImageNet, tieredImageNet). Saoirse is rebuilding those caches on Corpus rather than using ad-hoc copies. Timing matters: per Jun Varga, the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-10, so all three dataset caches must be regenerated on v2 paths before that date - I've put the cache work at the front of Saoirse's queue, target end of May, so we're not touching migration anywhere near our July close.

No budget asks. One risk: miniImageNet raw pickles come from an external mirror; Saoirse is archiving them internally this week.

Deshawn
